text: Add CI pipeline running lint and tests on minimum supported Python

rescope: maintainer wants no remote CI (remotes are storage only); a local venv-based dev pipeline that setup removes on install is the wanted shape. dropped `human` label (now agent-safe, no repo-owner access needed) and the T-151 dep accordingly. lowered p2->p3: it's an opt-in dev convenience, not an automatic guardrail.
